records.text: New signup alert -- *North Group* just created a workspace on pro.

decisions.rationale: Signup day 6, first project reached 8/12 and 1 invite sent, so some real momentum; but key_milestone still unreached and Sam never replied to either outreach (email:ccff0b4d, email:a1a63c4e). No tickets, so no blocker signal — just quiet drift with 8 days left.

draft.subject: One next step for North Group
draft.body:
Hi Sam,

You've got a first project going and an invite out the door — nice start. The usual next step from here is getting real work flowing inside that project, since projects are the main organizing unit and tasks live inside them.

If it's helpful, I'm happy to jump on a short call this week and walk through that with you, or just answer questions over email if that's easier.

One note in case it's useful: teammates can also be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Best,
Nadia
